info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Authorization Reversals API
info.description: The Card Authorization Reversals API allows businesses to process reversals for specific card authorizations effectively. This functionality is crucial for managing customer transactions, ensuring that erroneous charges can be corrected swiftly. Typical users of this API include financial services platforms and payment processors that need to handle transaction adjustments on behalf of their clients. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the reversal process and maintain a positive customer experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to reverse a specific card authorization using the provided authorization ID. It is used to cancel a previously approved authorization, effectively freeing up the funds that were held against the card for the transaction.

requestBody.description: This request is used to initiate a reversal for a specific card authorization identified by CARD-400045. Please ensure that all required fields are correctly populated before submitting the request.
